verdict: GO (6-seed, 6/6) — a spiking quench_fs GABA_A active-clear gate EVICTS the latched affect mood. After a HIGH episode, two LOW episodes drop the held mood to 0.000 of its high value (baseline ratchet 1.042; gate < 0.60), while the elapsed-TIME control (constant HIGH) holds at 0.984 (so the fall is caused by the LOWERED DRIVE, not by time), the pool RE-IGNITES to 1.006, and PERSISTENCE SURVIVES at 0.649 (baseline 0.62, gate >= 0.50). Instrument: NMDA-off held 0.000; the same-substrate evict_out lesion restores the ratchet at 1.045. numpy-CPU; NO sim/ edit.

pre_registered_gate.G2_drive_dependence: min(held[1],held[2])/held[0] >= 0.60 (constant-HIGH protocol; the fall must be caused by the lowered drive, not by elapsed time)
pre_registered_gate.G3_reignition: held[4]/held[0] >= 0.60 (eviction must not destroy the attractor)
pre_registered_gate.G6_lesion_power: evict_out gate=0 on the SAME substrate restores the ratchet (>= 0.90)
pre_registered_gate.A5_validity: during[0](evict ON) >= 0.5 x during[0](baseline); else UNDEFINED, not a pass
pre_registered_gate.verdict_rule: GO iff G1-G4 on >=5/6 seeds AND G5,G6 on >=5/6 AND the baseline reproduces the ratchet on >=5/6
pre_registered_gate.kill_criterion: no (weight x tau) point satisfies G1-G4 together => slow GABA_B feedback is KILLED as the METHOD; next method = intrinsic spike-frequency adaptation (cp_izh_a / cp_izh_d_increment on the affect pools, the --sfa arm)

mechanism: each affect pool drives its OWN slow-feedback interneuron (sfb_plus/sfb_minus/sfb_arousal, FS) which inhibits THAT SAME pool through RegionPathway(receptor='gaba_b') -> the metabotropic GIRK K+ conductance (E_K=-90 mV, tau=gabab_tau_ms), i.e. delayed self-inhibition that grows only under sustained incumbent firing. All eviction synapses sit behind ONE runtime transmission gate 'evict_out' (the same-substrate lesion). Appended LAST so neuron indices 0..359 and every baseline wiring draw are preserved.
HONEST_NOTE: numpy-CPU (the backend, not a host shortcut). GABA_B is ADDITIVE in this engine: a gaba_b-tagged synapse ALSO feeds the fast g_i, so the eviction limb is 'fast GABA_A + slow GABA_B', and the slowness attribution rests on the --arm fast control (enable_gabab=False, identical wiring). The eviction limb adds 45 neurons, so the no-wiring baseline arm is NOT substrate-identical; the load-bearing control is the same-substrate evict_out gate=0 arm (G6). NO sim/ edit.
